A.title: Unexpected Ways to Play — Original Reading
A.text:
A - Many people spend their leisure time playing football or basketball, but other activities combine familiar skills in surprising ways. In Brookdale, an annual sports festival encourages residents to try games they have never heard of. The organisers believe that a new activity can be enjoyable even when you are not immediately good at it. Participants do not need expensive equipment for most sessions.

B - One activity is called footgolf. Players kick a football across an outdoor course and aim for large holes in the ground. The rules are similar to golf: the aim is to finish each hole with as few kicks as possible. Unlike ordinary golf, players do not use clubs. At the festival, beginners are allowed to play in pairs, and an instructor explains the safety rules before they begin.

C - Another choice is indoor climbing. Visitors learn to move across a climbing wall while using ropes and safety equipment. Some people enjoy the physical challenge, while others prefer solving the problem of where to put their hands and feet. The organisers insist that beginners attend a short safety briefing. Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult. The exact cost of building the climbing wall is not published.

D - For those who prefer thinking games, the festival has a chess relay. Teams of four take turns running to a board and making one move. Players need to consider a move carefully, but they cannot stay at the board for more than thirty seconds. This means they must balance speed with concentration. The game is not part of the Olympic Games, and the festival makes no claim that it will become an Olympic sport.

E - The most unusual event may be the silent dance session. Everyone wears wireless headphones and listens to the same music. People who watch from outside cannot hear the songs, although they can see the dancers moving. A teacher leads an easy warm-up before the music starts. Some visitors have tried this activity for the first time, and many say it is more relaxing than they expected.

F - The festival is not a competition to find the best athlete. It is an opportunity to discover an activity that suits your interests and ability. Some visitors choose one sport, while others try several. The organisers hope the festival will encourage people to remain active after the weekend, but they have not measured whether the participants actually continue exercising.

B.title: A New Community Movement Space — Original Exam Reading
B.text:
A - In 2019, an unused warehouse in Millford was converted into a community movement centre. The founders, two sports teachers and a local architect, wanted a space where teenagers and adults could practise safe movement skills indoors. Instead of focusing on competition, the centre offers sessions in balance, jumping and obstacle-based fitness. Some members also practise simple routines in a nearby park.

B - Beginners attend an introduction session before joining a class. Instructors explain how to warm up, check equipment and choose movements appropriate to each person's ability. Students can practise alone or with others, but an instructor supervises all beginner sessions. The centre does not allow students to attempt difficult movements before they demonstrate the necessary skills.

C - The programme has changed as membership has grown. At first, the centre offered only two evening classes a week. Now it has morning and weekend sessions as well. Students can book a quiet practice hour if they prefer not to train in a busy group. The organisers have not announced a second location, although some members have suggested opening one.

D - The centre also runs short workshops for local schools. These sessions are designed to improve confidence, concentration and communication through simple movement tasks. Teachers report that many pupils enjoy collaborating to solve challenges. However, the centre has not conducted a scientific study of changes in students' academic grades.

E - Staff describe their approach as creative movement rather than a traditional team sport. Participants set personal goals, such as balancing longer or completing a safe obstacle sequence smoothly. The instructors say that supporting other learners is more important than finishing first. For this reason, the centre does not organise a championship.

F - In the future, the team hopes to improve access by offering more affordable classes and an equipment-loan service. The centre's director thinks these changes could encourage people who currently see exercise as too expensive. The director also hopes to work with a local charity, but no agreement has yet been signed.

activities.instruction_en: Compare hobbies with accurate comparative forms.
activities.instruction_vi: Ôn so sánh hơn theo ngữ cảnh giải trí.

items.question_en: Climbing is (challenging) ___ than walking for most beginners.
items.question_vi: Điền so sánh hơn challenging.
items.explanation_en: Long adjective takes more + adjective.
items.explanation_vi: Tính từ dài dùng more challenging.

items.question_en: A bicycle is (fast) ___ than walking on the same road.
items.question_vi: So sánh fast.
items.explanation_en: One syllable adjective typically takes -er.
items.explanation_vi: Fast là tính từ ngắn: faster.

items.question_en: This class is (good) ___ than the earlier one.
items.question_vi: So sánh good.
items.explanation_en: Good has irregular comparative better.
items.explanation_vi: Good bất quy tắc thành better.

items.question_en: A team game can be (social) ___ than an individual activity.
items.question_vi: So sánh social.
items.explanation_en: Use more with adjective social.
items.explanation_vi: Social thường dùng more social.

items.question_en: Which sentence is correct? A. more easier B. easier C. easyer
items.question_vi: Câu nào đúng chính tả so sánh?
items.explanation_en: Easy changes y to i and adds -er; do not use double comparison.
items.explanation_vi: Easy → easier; không thêm more.

activities.title: Exam practice: Passage B, T/F/NG + summary
activities.instruction_en: Read Passage B and answer exam-style evidence questions.
activities.instruction_vi: Đọc bài B, làm T/F/NG và summary như bài thi.

items.question_en: 1. The centre was previously a warehouse.
items.question_vi: Trung tâm trước đây là nhà kho.
items.explanation_en: A says an unused warehouse was converted.
items.explanation_vi: A nói nhà kho bỏ trống được cải tạo.

items.question_en: 2. The centre was founded by three architects.
items.question_vi: Ba kiến trúc sư sáng lập.
items.explanation_en: A says two sports teachers and one local architect.
items.explanation_vi: A nói hai giáo viên và một kiến trúc sư.

items.question_en: 3. All learners must practise in a group.
items.question_vi: Mọi người phải tập theo nhóm.
items.explanation_en: B says they can practise alone or with others.
items.explanation_vi: B cho phép một mình hoặc có nhóm.

items.question_en: 4. All classes are free of charge.
items.question_vi: Mọi lớp đều miễn phí.
items.explanation_en: F mentions plans for more affordable classes, but not a full price or free admission.
items.explanation_vi: Chỉ nói dự định giảm chi phí, không nói miễn phí.

items.question_en: 5. There were only two evening classes initially.
items.question_vi: Ban đầu chỉ có 2 lớp tối.
items.explanation_en: C says exactly two evening classes at first.
items.explanation_vi: C ghi ban đầu hai lớp buổi tối.

items.question_en: 6. The centre has confirmed a second site.
items.question_vi: Đã xác nhận cơ sở thứ hai.
items.explanation_en: C says no second location has been announced.
items.explanation_vi: C nói chưa công bố cơ sở khác.

items.question_en: 7. Instructors have measured better school grades.
items.question_vi: Đã có nghiên cứu cho thấy điểm học tăng.
items.explanation_en: D says no scientific study of changes in grades was conducted.
items.explanation_vi: D ghi rõ chưa nghiên cứu tác động lên điểm số.

items.question_en: 8. The centre has won an international competition.
items.question_vi: Trung tâm từng thắng giải quốc tế.
items.explanation_en: No international prize is mentioned.
items.explanation_vi: Không có thông tin về giải quốc tế.

items.question_en: 9. Members set their own ___. (goals / exams / prices)
items.question_vi: Người học tự đặt mục tiêu.
items.explanation_en: E explicitly says participants set personal goals.
items.explanation_vi: E nói set personal goals.

items.question_en: 10. The new loan service will offer ___. (equipment / cars / books)
items.question_vi: Dịch vụ cho mượn gì?
items.explanation_en: F describes an equipment-loan service.
items.explanation_vi: F nói dịch vụ mượn dụng cụ.

items.question_en: 11. The centre is not trying to create a ___. (championship / magazine / college)
items.question_vi: Không tổ chức cuộc thi nào?
items.explanation_en: E states it does not organise a championship.
items.explanation_vi: E nói không có giải vô địch.

items.question_en: 12. Beginner classes are watched by an ___. (instructor / architect / employer)
items.question_vi: Lớp người mới do ai giám sát?
items.explanation_en: B says an instructor supervises all beginner sessions.
items.explanation_vi: B nêu người hướng dẫn giám sát.

items.question_en: 13. Pupils work together to solve ___. (challenges / payments / lectures)
items.question_vi: Học sinh hợp tác giải quyết gì?
items.explanation_en: D talks about collaborating to solve challenges.
items.explanation_vi: D nói hợp tác để vượt thử thách.

activities.title: Collocations for leisure activities
activities.instruction_en: Choose natural verb + activity combinations.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn động từ đi với hoạt động giải trí.

items.question_en: Choose: go / play / do jogging
items.question_vi: Chọn động từ với jogging.
items.explanation_en: Go is used with many -ing outdoor activities.
items.explanation_vi: Go + V-ing dùng nhiều hoạt động như go jogging.

items.question_en: Choose: play / go / make basketball
items.question_vi: Chọn với basketball.
items.explanation_en: Ball games usually use play.
items.explanation_vi: Môn bóng thường dùng play.

items.question_en: Choose: do / play / visit yoga
items.question_vi: Chọn với yoga.
items.explanation_en: Yoga typically collocates with do.
items.explanation_vi: Yoga thường đi với do.

items.question_en: Choose: go to / go for the cinema
items.question_vi: Đi xem phim dùng cách nào?
items.explanation_en: The destination takes go to + place.
items.explanation_vi: Go to + địa điểm; go to the cinema.

items.question_en: Choose: join a club / join to club
items.question_vi: Tham gia câu lạc bộ?
items.explanation_en: Join takes a direct object, not “to” here.
items.explanation_vi: Join + danh từ, không dùng to.

activities.title: Evaluate a weak Task 2 paragraph
activities.instruction_en: Judge a short original weak student paragraph and identify what is missing.
activities.instruction_vi: Đánh giá đoạn yếu do mình tự biên soạn.

items.question_en: Sample: “Nowadays phones exist. I think phones are bad. People use phones. Many people use phones every day.” Does this paragraph develop one reason?
items.question_vi: Đoạn này có giải thích lý do cụ thể không?
items.explanation_en: It repeats the idea instead of explaining a mechanism or example.
items.explanation_vi: Chỉ lặp ý dùng điện thoại, không có lý do/ví dụ.

items.question_en: Is “phones are bad” a precise argument for a leisure-time essay?
items.question_vi: Phones are bad có phải ý cụ thể?
items.explanation_en: It does not specify what harm occurs or for whom.
items.explanation_vi: Không nêu tác hại cụ thể hoặc nhóm đối tượng.

items.question_en: Rewrite the topic sentence precisely.
items.question_vi: Viết lại câu chủ đề cụ thể.
items.answer: Excessive screen time may reduce the time children spend on outdoor exercise.
items.explanation_en: It specifies a cause and an effect relevant to leisure.
items.explanation_vi: Câu nói rõ việc dùng màn hình quá mức làm giảm vận động.

items.question_en: Add a specific supporting example.
items.question_vi: Thêm ví dụ hỗ trợ.
items.answer: For instance, a child who plays video games every evening may have little time left for cycling.
items.explanation_en: A realistic example explains the claim without inventing statistics.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ thực tế giải thích ý, không bịa số liệu.

activities.title: Check paragraph structure and task response
activities.instruction_en: Examine introduction, body paragraphs and conclusion.
activities.instruction_vi: Kiểm bố cục và trả lời đúng câu hỏi.

items.question_en: Task: “Do children spend less time outdoors today than in the past? Agree/disagree.” Should you state your position?
items.question_vi: Đề agree/disagree cần quan điểm không?
items.explanation_en: A clear position is necessary throughout.
items.explanation_vi: Phải thể hiện quan điểm xuyên suốt.

items.question_en: What is a suitable four-paragraph order?
items.question_vi: Thứ tự bố cục 4 đoạn?
items.explanation_en: Body paragraphs develop two coherent points.
items.explanation_vi: Hai đoạn thân bài mỗi đoạn phát triển ý rõ.

items.question_en: Is an unrelated story about a holiday a strong example for screen-time effects?
items.question_vi: Chuyện chuyến đi không liên quan có nên viết?
items.explanation_en: Examples must illustrate the main claim.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ phải liên quan luận điểm.

items.question_en: How many words does IELTS Writing Task 2 require at least?
items.question_vi: Task 2 tối thiểu bao nhiêu từ?
items.explanation_en: The IELTS Task 2 minimum is 250 words.
items.explanation_vi: Task 2 phải viết ít nhất 250 từ.

activities.title: Grammar clinic: edit flawed sentences
activities.instruction_en: Correct tense, agreement, articles and double comparatives.
activities.instruction_vi: Sửa lỗi thì, hòa hợp, mạo từ và so sánh.

items.question_en: Correct: “Nowadays children spends many time online.”
items.question_vi: Sửa câu ngữ pháp.
items.answer: Nowadays children spend a lot of time online.
items.explanation_en: Plural children takes spend; time is uncountable, so use much/a lot of.
items.explanation_vi: Children số nhiều → spend; time không đếm được → a lot of.

items.question_en: Correct: “In the past people was more active.”
items.question_vi: Sửa was với people.
items.answer: In the past, people were more active.
items.explanation_en: People is plural; were, not was.
items.explanation_vi: People số nhiều → were.

items.question_en: Correct: “Exercise is more healthier than sitting all day.”
items.question_vi: Sửa more healthier.
items.answer: Exercise is healthier than sitting all day.
items.explanation_en: Do not use both more and -er.
items.explanation_vi: Không dùng more và -er cùng lúc.

items.question_en: Correct: “There are too much video games.”
items.question_vi: Sửa much games.
items.answer: There are too many video games.
items.explanation_en: Games are plural count nouns.
items.explanation_vi: Games đếm được số nhiều → many.

items.question_en: Correct: “This activity make students confident.”
items.question_vi: Sửa chia động từ.
items.explanation_en: Singular subject requires makes in present simple.
items.explanation_vi: This activity là số ít → makes.

activities.title: Compare past and present
activities.instruction_en: Choose accurate time expressions and structures.
activities.instruction_vi: So sánh thói quen quá khứ và hiện tại.

items.question_en: “___, families often played board games together.” (In the past / Tomorrow)
items.question_vi: Cụm chỉ quá khứ?
items.explanation_en: This sentence refers to past habits.
items.explanation_vi: Câu mô tả thói quen ngày xưa.

items.question_en: “___, many people watch films on their phones.” (Nowadays / Years ago)
items.question_vi: Dùng trạng từ nào cho hiện tại?
items.explanation_en: Nowadays means at the present time.
items.explanation_vi: Nowadays chỉ thời hiện nay.

items.question_en: “People ___ walk to the shops more often.” (used to / use to)
items.question_vi: Dùng used to diễn tả thói quen cũ.
items.explanation_en: Positive past habit uses used to + base verb.
items.explanation_vi: Used to + V nguyên mẫu diễn tả từng thường.

items.question_en: “At present, children spend ___ time outdoors than before.” (less / fewer)
items.question_vi: Điền với time.
items.explanation_en: Time is uncountable in this context.
items.explanation_vi: Time không đếm được → less.

items.question_en: “In the past, there were ___ online games than today.” (fewer / less)
items.question_vi: Điền với games.
items.explanation_en: Games are plural count nouns.
items.explanation_vi: Games đếm được số nhiều → fewer.

activities.title: Comparative grammar in arguments
activities.instruction_en: Complete comparative forms.
activities.instruction_vi: Điền cấu trúc so sánh hơn.

items.question_en: Joining a club can be ___ (expensive) than jogging.
items.question_vi: So sánh expensive.
items.explanation_en: Long adjective expensive takes more.
items.explanation_vi: Tính từ dài → more expensive.

items.question_en: A walk is ___ (easy) to organise than a football match.
items.question_vi: So sánh easy.
items.explanation_en: Change -y to -ier.
items.explanation_vi: Easy → easier.

items.question_en: A balanced routine may be ___ (healthy) than sitting all day.
items.question_vi: So sánh healthy.
items.explanation_en: Healthy changes y to i and adds -er.
items.explanation_vi: Healthy → healthier.

items.question_en: The same sport may be ___ (interesting) for one person than another.
items.question_vi: So sánh interesting.
items.explanation_en: Interesting is long and uses more.
items.explanation_vi: Interesting dài → more interesting.

items.question_en: Which is correct? A. more faster B. faster C. fastlier
items.question_vi: Cách nói nhanh hơn?
items.explanation_en: Fast has comparative faster.
items.explanation_vi: Fast → faster.

activities.title: Linking ideas and opposing views
activities.instruction_en: Match connectors to their discourse functions.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghép từ nối với chức năng.

items.question_en: “However” signals A. contrast B. example C. conclusion
items.question_vi: However là từ nối gì?
items.explanation_en: However introduces an opposing or limiting idea.
items.explanation_vi: However mở ý trái chiều.

items.question_en: “For example” signals A. reason B. illustration C. sequence
items.question_vi: For example dùng làm gì?
items.explanation_en: It introduces a concrete illustration.
items.explanation_vi: Dẫn ví dụ.

items.question_en: “In addition” signals A. extra point B. past time C. disagreement
items.question_vi: In addition nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: It adds related evidence or another point.
items.explanation_vi: Bổ sung luận điểm/bằng chứng.

items.question_en: “As a result” introduces A. cause B. consequence C. question
items.question_vi: As a result dẫn điều gì?
items.explanation_en: It connects an effect to its previous cause.
items.explanation_vi: Kết nối hệ quả với nguyên nhân.

items.question_en: “On the other hand” normally introduces A. another perspective B. example C. agreement only
items.question_vi: On the other hand giới thiệu điều gì?
items.explanation_en: It presents a contrasting perspective.
items.explanation_vi: Đưa góc nhìn trái ngược.

activities.title: Brainstorm advantages and drawbacks
activities.instruction_en: Prepare arguments on organised free-time clubs for children.
activities.instruction_vi: Lên ý lợi ích và bất lợi khi trẻ tham gia câu lạc bộ.

items.question_en: State one advantage of a planned sports club.
items.question_vi: Nêu một lợi ích của câu lạc bộ thể thao.
items.answer: Children may become fitter and learn teamwork.
items.explanation_en: The answer identifies a specific benefit.
items.explanation_vi: Ý chỉ rõ sức khỏe và tinh thần đồng đội.

items.question_en: Explain why regular sessions can help.
items.question_vi: Giải thích vì sao lịch tập đều đặn hữu ích.
items.answer: Regular sessions give children a routine and opportunities to practise new skills.
items.explanation_en: Explain the mechanism behind the benefit.
items.explanation_vi: Giải thích luyện đều tạo thói quen và kỹ năng.

items.question_en: State one disadvantage of too many organised activities.
items.question_vi: Nêu một bất lợi của lịch kín.
items.answer: Children may have too little unstructured time to rest or play creatively.
items.explanation_en: The drawback is relevant to the question.
items.explanation_vi: Trẻ có thể thiếu thời gian tự do để nghỉ/nghĩ sáng tạo.

items.question_en: Give a realistic example for this disadvantage.
items.question_vi: Ví dụ cho bất lợi.
items.answer: A child attending clubs every afternoon may not have enough time for family dinners.
items.explanation_en: A specific illustration supports the drawback.
items.explanation_vi: Ví dụ cụ thể làm rõ luận điểm.

activities.title: PAGE 115 / LINKING EXPRESSIONS – eight gaps
activities.instruction_en: Complete eight original argument sentences using one suitable linker each.
activities.instruction_vi: Trang 115: điền đủ 8 từ/cụm nối ý vào bài luận mới.

items.question_en: 1. “This essay will consider both sides and give ___.” (my own opinion / firstly)
items.question_vi: Điền cụm vào mở bài.
items.explanation_en: After give, a noun phrase is needed; my own opinion fits.
items.explanation_vi: Sau give cần cụm danh từ; my own opinion đúng.

items.question_en: 2. “___, organised activities can help children build friendships.” (Firstly / Unfortunately)
items.question_vi: Mở ý lợi ích thứ nhất?
items.explanation_en: Firstly introduces the first point.
items.explanation_vi: Firstly giới thiệu luận điểm đầu.

items.question_en: 3. “___, regular exercise can improve physical health.” (Secondly / In conclusion)
items.question_vi: Ý tích cực thứ hai?
items.explanation_en: Secondly develops the next point in a sequence.
items.explanation_vi: Secondly dẫn ý thứ hai.

items.question_en: 4. “___, busy schedules can make children feel stressed.” (However / For instance)
items.question_vi: Chuyển sang bất lợi?
items.explanation_en: The second side contrasts with benefits.
items.explanation_vi: However tạo ý đối lập lợi ích.

items.question_en: 5. “___, a child with clubs every evening may have little time for homework.” (For example / Overall)
items.question_vi: Đưa ví dụ cụ thể?
items.explanation_en: A concrete illustrative case follows.
items.explanation_vi: For example dẫn ví dụ.

items.question_en: 6. “___, children need time to choose activities freely.” (In addition / By contrast)
items.question_vi: Bổ sung một điểm khác?
items.explanation_en: Adds another related concern.
items.explanation_vi: In addition bổ sung luận điểm.

items.question_en: 7. “Parents should leave some afternoons free. ___, children can rest and make their own decisions.” (As a result / Despite)
items.question_vi: Nêu kết quả của việc để trống thời gian?
items.explanation_en: It links the action with its consequence.
items.explanation_vi: As a result dẫn hệ quả.

items.question_en: 8. “___, a balance between clubs and free play is the best approach.” (In conclusion / Firstly)
items.question_vi: Chốt lại bài?
items.explanation_en: A conclusion sums up the overall position.
items.explanation_vi: In conclusion dùng để kết luận.

activities.title: Plan arguments for a sports requirement
activities.instruction_en: Decide which points support agree or disagree; build a balanced response.
activities.instruction_vi: Lập dàn ý về quy định học thể dục ở trường.

items.question_en: “Sports improve physical health.” Supports A. agree B. disagree
items.question_vi: Thể thao cải thiện sức khỏe ủng hộ phía nào?
items.explanation_en: Health is a reason to require sport.
items.explanation_vi: Sức khỏe là lý do ủng hộ.

items.question_en: “Some students have disabilities and need adapted activities.” Supports A. absolute requirement without changes B. a flexible requirement
items.question_vi: Nên điều chỉnh cho học sinh có nhu cầu khác nhau?
items.explanation_en: Inclusive adaptation is a reason against a rigid one-size-fits-all policy.
items.explanation_vi: Cần linh hoạt thay vì áp dụng cứng nhắc.

items.question_en: Write a clear thesis that partly agrees.
items.question_vi: Viết thesis đồng ý một phần.
items.answer: I agree that schools should offer regular physical education, but activities should be adapted to students’ needs.
items.explanation_en: The position is specific and qualified.
items.explanation_vi: Lập trường vừa rõ vừa có điều kiện hợp lý.

items.question_en: Plan two body paragraphs with examples.
items.question_vi: Lập hai ý thân bài có ví dụ.
items.answer: Body 1: health and teamwork; e.g. weekly games. Body 2: inclusive flexible activities; e.g. swimming or walking as alternatives.
items.explanation_en: Two distinct points with illustrations create a coherent plan.
items.explanation_vi: Hai đoạn có luận điểm khác nhau và ví dụ.

activities.title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – independent essay
activities.instruction_en: Write at least 250 words on leisure time, then compare with the model.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết tối thiểu 250 từ; đối chiếu bài mẫu.

items.question_en: Essay: “People spend less of their free time being physically active now than in the past. To what extent do you agree or disagree?” Write 250+ words.
items.question_vi: Viết bài 250+ từ về việc ngày nay người ta ít vận động hơn quá khứ.
items.answer: Suggested stance: largely agree, but note that participation differs among individuals. Intro: clear position. Body 1: screen-based leisure and transport. Body 2: access to gyms and modern clubs provides alternatives. Conclusion: restate overall judgement.
items.explanation_en: This is an open task: assess task response, coherent argument, evidence, range and accuracy.
items.explanation_vi: Đề mở: đánh giá quan điểm, mạch lạc, ví dụ, ngôn ngữ; không tự chấm band máy.

items.question_en: Write a topic sentence comparing the two periods.
items.question_vi: Viết một câu chủ đề so sánh xưa nay.
items.answer: Compared with the past, many people now choose screen-based entertainment instead of outdoor games.
items.explanation_en: Uses comparison and identifies the behaviour being discussed.
items.explanation_vi: Câu vừa so sánh vừa nêu rõ thay đổi thói quen.

items.question_en: Write an appropriate conclusion sentence.
items.question_vi: Viết câu kết phù hợp.
items.answer: Overall, I believe daily routines have become less active, although modern leisure facilities give people more choices.
items.explanation_en: The conclusion maintains a nuanced position without new evidence.
items.explanation_vi: Kết luận nhất quán, không thêm luận điểm mới.

activities.title: Editing checklist and second Task 2 prompt
activities.instruction_en: Evaluate organisation, linking and grammar after writing.
activities.instruction_vi: Tự soát bài sau khi viết.

items.question_en: Your essay is 236 words. Is this at least 250 words?
items.question_vi: Bài 236 từ đủ số từ tối thiểu?
items.explanation_en: Task 2 asks for at least 250 words.
items.explanation_vi: Task 2 tối thiểu 250 từ.

items.question_en: Which is best for a conclusion? A. A brand-new reason B. A brief restatement of your position
items.question_vi: Kết luận nên làm gì?
items.answer: B. A brief restatement of your position
items.explanation_en: Conclusions synthesize existing arguments, not add a new point.
items.explanation_vi: Kết luận tổng hợp ý đã nêu.

items.question_en: “Most children is” – correct subject–verb agreement?
items.question_vi: Most children đi với is đúng không?
items.explanation_en: Children is plural.
items.explanation_vi: Children là số nhiều → are.

items.question_en: Alternative exam task: “Physical education should be compulsory in all schools.” Write a 250+ word agree/disagree essay.
items.question_vi: Đề bổ sung: Thể dục nên bắt buộc ở mọi trường. Viết 250+ từ.
items.answer: Possible response: agree with regular physical education but require suitable, accessible options; develop health, social skills and inclusive conditions.
items.explanation_en: There is no single fixed essay. Check opinion, examples, cohesion, grammar and length.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án mở; kiểm lập trường rõ, minh chứng, liên kết, ngữ pháp, đủ 250 từ.

items.question_en: List three personal errors you will check next time.
items.question_vi: Nêu ba lỗi sẽ kiểm lần sau.
items.answer: Subject–verb agreement; repeated vocabulary; missing examples.
items.explanation_en: A targeted error log helps deliberate practice.
items.explanation_vi: Ghi lỗi theo nhóm giúp ôn hiệu quả.

activities.title: Useful direction language
activities.instruction_en: Match travel directions with plain meanings.
activities.instruction_vi: Nối cụm chỉ đường với nghĩa.

items.question_en: “Go straight ahead” means A. continue forward B. turn around C. stop
items.question_vi: Go straight ahead nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: Straight ahead means continuing in the same direction.
items.explanation_vi: Đi thẳng không đổi hướng.

items.question_en: “Opposite the café” means A. inside B. across from C. behind
items.question_vi: Opposite the café nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: Opposite refers to facing across a space or road.
items.explanation_vi: Đối diện qua đường hoặc khoảng trống.

items.question_en: “Turn right” means A. move to your right B. go back C. go left
items.question_vi: Turn right nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: A right turn changes direction to the right.
items.explanation_vi: Rẽ phải.

items.question_en: “Next to the library” means A. beside it B. far away C. above it
items.question_vi: Next to nghĩa?
items.explanation_en: Next to indicates an adjacent position.
items.explanation_vi: Ở cạnh nhau.

activities.title: Give a simple route
activities.instruction_en: Use sequential language before listening.
activities.instruction_vi: Tự nói tuyến đường trước khi nghe.

items.question_en: Describe how to go from your home to a nearby shop using two turns.
items.question_vi: Tự mô tả đường từ nhà tới tiệm có hai lần rẽ.
items.answer: Go straight along my street, turn left at the crossing, then turn right after the café.
items.explanation_en: Use clear sequential verbs and landmarks.
items.explanation_vi: Dùng các bước liên tiếp và mốc dễ nhận.

items.question_en: Which connector introduces the next direction? A. Then B. Although C. Despite
items.question_vi: Từ nào dẫn bước tiếp theo?
items.explanation_en: Then sequences actions.
items.explanation_vi: Then dùng để nối thứ tự.

items.question_en: A crossroads is A. a place where roads meet B. a lake C. a railway platform
items.question_vi: Crossroads nghĩa?
items.answer: A. a place where roads meet
items.explanation_en: Roads intersect at crossroads.
items.explanation_vi: Nơi các đường giao nhau.

activities.title: Understand the original park map
activities.instruction_en: Study map A–H. Identify entrance, north and key features.
activities.instruction_vi: Quan sát bản đồ A–H và hướng bắc.

items.question_en: Where is the main entrance on the park map? A. north B. south C. west
items.question_vi: Lối vào chính phía nào?
items.explanation_en: The map labels the entrance at its bottom edge.
items.explanation_vi: Bản đồ ghi ENTRANCE ở mép dưới.

items.question_en: Which side of the park is the lake?
items.question_vi: Hồ phía nào?
items.explanation_en: The lake is shown at the top with a north arrow.
items.explanation_vi: Hồ ở phía bắc theo mũi tên N.

items.question_en: Which letter lies directly west of the centre crossroads?
items.question_vi: Chữ nào ngay tây giao lộ trung tâm?
items.explanation_en: C is left of the central crossing when north is up.
items.explanation_vi: C ở bên trái giao lộ theo hướng bắc lên trên.

items.question_en: Which letter is in the south-eastern part of the park?
items.question_vi: Chữ nào ở phía đông nam của công viên?
items.explanation_en: F is lower-right of the entrance corridor.
items.explanation_vi: F ở bên phải phía dưới gần lối vào.

activities.title: Map labelling: first message
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track A. Write A–H, ignoring old locations.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track A và điền chữ cái A–H theo vị trí cuối.

items.question_en: 1. Information office: ___
items.question_vi: Văn phòng thông tin ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: From the southern entrance, the first building on the left is E.
items.explanation_vi: Từ lối vào phía nam, bên trái đầu tiên là E.

items.question_en: 2. Children’s playground: ___
items.question_vi: Sân chơi trẻ em?
items.explanation_en: The playground is right of the central crossroads: D.
items.explanation_vi: Bên phải ngã tư giữa là D.

items.question_en: 3. Picnic shelter: ___
items.question_vi: Chòi dã ngoại?
items.explanation_en: West of the northern lake is H.
items.explanation_vi: Phía tây hồ là H.

items.question_en: 4. Climbing area: ___
items.question_vi: Khu leo trèo?
items.explanation_en: East of the lake is G.
items.explanation_vi: Phía đông hồ là G.

items.question_en: 5. Activity studio: ___
items.question_vi: Phòng hoạt động?
items.explanation_en: The current site is west of the crossroads, C; the former lake location is a distractor.
items.explanation_vi: Vị trí hiện tại tây ngã tư là C; gần hồ là thông tin cũ.

activities.title: Map labelling: additional visitors
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track B and identify four updated facilities.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe Track B và xác định 4 cơ sở mới.

items.question_en: 1. Outdoor gym: ___
items.question_vi: Phòng tập ngoài trời?
items.explanation_en: North-east of the lake corresponds to G.
items.explanation_vi: Đông-bắc hồ là G; dự định cũ ở cổng bị bỏ.

items.question_en: 2. Bicycle repair desk: ___
items.question_vi: Quầy sửa xe đạp?
items.explanation_en: The south-eastern section of the park, beside the café, is F.
items.explanation_vi: Phía đông nam của công viên, cạnh quán cà phê, là F.

items.question_en: 3. Art workshop: ___
items.question_vi: Xưởng nghệ thuật?
items.explanation_en: Across from the playground, on the west side of the crossroads, is C.
items.explanation_vi: Đối diện sân chơi qua đường ở phía tây là C.

items.question_en: 4. Quiet reading corner: ___
items.question_vi: Góc đọc yên tĩnh?
items.explanation_en: North-west of the lake corresponds to H.
items.explanation_vi: Tây-bắc hồ là H.

activities.title: Recognising distractors
activities.instruction_en: Identify an old plan, a correction or an irrelevant detail.
activities.instruction_vi: Nhận diện thông tin cũ, được sửa hoặc gây nhiễu.

items.question_en: Track A: “The studio used to be by the lake. It has moved west of the crossroads.” Final clue?
items.question_vi: Phòng hoạt động cuối ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: The phrase “has moved” cancels the old position.
items.explanation_vi: Has moved xóa vị trí cũ gần hồ.

items.question_en: Track B: “We considered near the southern entrance, but that plan changed.” Is the entrance the answer?
items.question_vi: Cổng nam có phải đáp án cuối?
items.explanation_en: This is a rejected proposal.
items.explanation_vi: Đây là dự định đã bỏ.

items.question_en: Track G: climbing wall near A. north gate B. football field
items.question_vi: Vách leo cuối ở đâu?
items.explanation_en: The speaker corrects an earlier advertisement about the field.
items.explanation_vi: Bãi bóng là quảng cáo cũ, north gate mới đúng.

items.question_en: Track G: beginner class starts at A. 10:15 B. 10:45
items.question_vi: Lớp mới bắt đầu mấy giờ?
items.explanation_en: 10:15 is explicitly the original plan; 10:45 is the updated time.
items.explanation_vi: 10:15 là kế hoạch ban đầu, 10:45 là cuối.

activities.title: Map of a building: Arts Centre
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track C and label rooms on the floor plan.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe C, điền phòng trong sơ đồ nhà.

items.question_en: 1. Café: ___
items.question_vi: Quán cà phê?
items.explanation_en: Right immediately after the south entrance is bottom-right H.
items.explanation_vi: Phía phải ngay cổng nam: H.

items.question_en: 2. Toilets: ___
items.question_vi: Nhà vệ sinh?
items.explanation_en: Opposite the café on the left is D.
items.explanation_vi: Đối diện H bên trái: D.

items.question_en: 3. Theatre: ___
items.question_vi: Rạp biểu diễn?
items.explanation_en: Second room on the left from the entrance is C.
items.explanation_vi: Phòng thứ hai bên trái đi từ cổng: C.

items.question_en: 4. Music studio: ___
items.question_vi: Phòng nhạc?
items.explanation_en: Directly across from C is G.
items.explanation_vi: Đối diện C bên phải là G.

items.question_en: 5. Gallery: ___
items.question_vi: Phòng tranh?
items.explanation_en: Left at the far north end is A.
items.explanation_vi: Cuối hành lang phía bắc bên trái là A.

items.question_en: 6. Information desk: ___
items.question_vi: Quầy thông tin?
items.explanation_en: Right at the far north end is E.
items.explanation_vi: Cuối hành lang phía bắc bên phải là E.

activities.title: Map types and orientation
activities.instruction_en: Compare a town map, park map and floor plan.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân biệt bản đồ thị trấn, công viên và sơ đồ phòng.

items.question_en: Which map is best for locating rooms inside one building?
items.question_vi: Loại nào dùng tìm phòng trong tòa nhà?
items.explanation_en: Floor plans show interior rooms and corridors.
items.explanation_vi: Floor plan mô tả phòng và hành lang.

items.question_en: Which direction is above east on a standard north-up map?
items.question_vi: Trên phía đông trong bản đồ bắc lên là đâu?
items.explanation_en: North is up; east is right.
items.explanation_vi: Bắc lên trên; đông bên phải.

items.question_en: “Across the corridor” is similar to A. opposite B. behind C. under
items.question_vi: Across the corridor nghĩa gần?
items.explanation_en: The rooms face each other across the corridor.
items.explanation_vi: Hai phòng đối diện qua hành lang.

items.question_en: Name two landmarks useful for giving directions.
items.question_vi: Kể 2 mốc hữu ích khi chỉ đường.
items.answer: the bridge and the main entrance
items.explanation_en: Distinct landmarks reduce ambiguity.
items.explanation_vi: Mốc rõ như cầu và cổng giảm nhầm đường.

activities.title: Activity-camp map practice
activities.instruction_en: Use Map A–H to locate facilities from oral directions.
activities.instruction_vi: Dùng bản đồ nghe theo mốc không đoán trước.

items.question_en: 1. On Track A, what landmark comes before the playground?
items.question_vi: Trước sân chơi là mốc nào?
items.explanation_en: The guide says go straight to the crossroads, then look right.
items.explanation_vi: Nghe đến ngã tư giữa rồi nhìn phải.

items.question_en: 2. The picnic shelter is on which side of the lake?
items.question_vi: Chòi dã ngoại phía nào của hồ?
items.explanation_en: Track A explicitly states west of the water.
items.explanation_vi: Audio A nói phía tây hồ.

items.question_en: 3. Which expression signals a correction? A. used to B. next to C. finally
items.question_vi: Từ nào báo vị trí đã đổi?
items.explanation_en: Used to indicates a previous state; later information is current.
items.explanation_vi: Used to mô tả quá khứ, sau đó cần nghe cập nhật.

items.question_en: 4. Can you choose a map label without checking north?
items.question_vi: Có nên đoán chữ khi chưa xác định hướng bắc?
items.explanation_en: Orientation is essential for left/right and east/west directions.
items.explanation_vi: Cần xác định phương hướng trước.

activities.title: Exam simulation: forest-centre map
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Track D; fill 8 labels or locations and check distractors.
activities.instruction_vi: Đề mô phỏng nghe bản đồ 8 câu; kiểm bẫy.

items.question_en: 1. Cycle hire desk letter: ___
items.question_vi: Quầy thuê xe đạp chữ nào?
items.explanation_en: First building on the right from the south entrance is F.
items.explanation_vi: Ngay phải gần cổng nam: F.

items.question_en: 2. Information office letter: ___
items.question_vi: Quầy thông tin chữ nào?
items.explanation_en: Opposite F on the left is E.
items.explanation_vi: Đối diện F ở trái: E.

items.question_en: 3. Picnic area letter: ___
items.question_vi: Khu dã ngoại chữ nào?
items.explanation_en: Eastern middle side of the path is D.
items.explanation_vi: Phía đông ở giữa đường đi: D.

items.question_en: 4. Outdoor classroom letter: ___
items.question_vi: Lớp học ngoài trời chữ nào?
items.explanation_en: Across from D on the west is C.
items.explanation_vi: Đối diện D là C phía tây.

items.question_en: 5. Observation point letter: ___
items.question_vi: Điểm quan sát chữ nào?
items.explanation_en: North-west of the lake is H; the east suggestion was rejected.
items.explanation_vi: Tây-bắc hồ là H; dự tính phía đông đã bị bỏ.

items.question_en: 6. Wildlife exhibition letter: ___
items.question_vi: Triển lãm động vật chữ nào?
items.explanation_en: The upper eastern slot B is next to the illustrated bridge.
items.explanation_vi: Ô B phía đông gần cầu minh họa.

items.question_en: 7. Why is the café not an answer inside the park?
items.question_vi: Tại sao quán cà phê không điền bản đồ?
items.answer: It is outside the park, south of the entrance.
items.explanation_en: The audio explicitly puts it outside the mapped park.
items.explanation_vi: Audio nói quán ở ngoài công viên, dưới cổng.

items.question_en: 8. “We first planned ... but rejected it” means the first location is a ...
items.question_vi: Vị trí được nhắc đầu rồi bác bỏ gọi là gì?
items.explanation_en: A rejected plan is a plausible but wrong option.
items.explanation_vi: Thông tin gây nhiễu, không phải đáp án.

activities.title: Discuss everyday free-time activities
activities.instruction_en: Give full but concise Part 1 responses.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời Speaking Part 1 có lý do.

items.question_en: What do you normally do after school or work?
items.question_vi: Sau giờ học/làm thường làm gì?
items.answer: I usually listen to music or play basketball because these activities help me relax.
items.explanation_en: Answer directly, then add a reason.
items.explanation_vi: Trả lời trực tiếp + lý do.

items.question_en: Do you prefer activities alone or with friends?
items.question_vi: Thích hoạt động một mình hay với bạn?
items.answer: I prefer playing sports with friends because it is more social and motivating.
items.explanation_en: Preference + because demonstrates a full answer.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu sở thích + lý do.

items.question_en: Choose: play football / do football
items.question_vi: Chọn collocation đúng.
items.explanation_en: Ball games normally use play.
items.explanation_vi: Môn bóng dùng play.

activities.title: Positive adjectives for hobbies
activities.instruction_en: Use a varied and accurate adjective to express feelings.
activities.instruction_vi: Dùng tính từ tích cực để mô tả trải nghiệm.

items.question_en: Yoga is often ___ (relaxing / dangerous) when practised appropriately.
items.question_vi: Mô tả yoga bình thường.
items.explanation_en: Relaxing describes an activity that helps someone feel calm.
items.explanation_vi: Relaxing nghĩa thư giãn.

items.question_en: “I enjoyed the concert” ≈ “The concert was ___.” (enjoyable / exhausted)
items.question_vi: Từ nghĩa tương đương?
items.explanation_en: Enjoyable describes the experience, not the tired person.
items.explanation_vi: Enjoyable mô tả trải nghiệm thú vị.

items.question_en: Give two positive adjectives about one sport.
items.question_vi: Dùng hai tính từ tích cực với một môn.
items.answer: Swimming is refreshing and enjoyable for me.
items.explanation_en: Adjectives should relate logically to the sport and speaker.
items.explanation_vi: Tính từ gắn hợp lý với trải nghiệm cá nhân.

activities.title: Negative adjectives without exaggeration
activities.instruction_en: Describe challenging, tiring or inconvenient activities.
activities.instruction_vi: Dùng tính từ tiêu cực hoặc trung tính chính xác.

items.question_en: After a long hike, I feel ___ (exhausted / exhausting).
items.question_vi: Sau leo núi dài, mình cảm thấy?
items.explanation_en: -ed adjective describes the person’s feeling; -ing describes a cause.
items.explanation_vi: -ed nói cảm xúc người, -ing nói hoạt động gây cảm giác.

items.question_en: A scary climbing activity could be ___ (frightening / frightened).
items.question_vi: Hoạt động có thể đáng sợ là?
items.explanation_en: -ing adjective describes the experience.
items.explanation_vi: Frightening mô tả hoạt động.

items.question_en: Say one activity you do not enjoy and explain politely.
items.question_vi: Nêu hoạt động không thích và lý do.
items.answer: I do not really enjoy long-distance running because I find it tiring.
items.explanation_en: Personal preferences should be clear without extreme claims.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu sở thích cá nhân tự nhiên, rõ lý do.

activities.title: Listen to a Part 1 sample
activities.instruction_en: Use Track E to identify how a speaker extends simple answers.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe E và nhận ra cách mở rộng câu.

items.question_en: What sport does the candidate play?
items.question_vi: Thí sinh chơi môn gì?
items.explanation_en: The first answer explicitly names basketball.
items.explanation_vi: Câu đầu nói basketball.

items.question_en: Which hobby does the candidate want to learn?
items.question_vi: Muốn học sở thích gì?
items.explanation_en: They say they would like to learn photography.
items.explanation_vi: Nói muốn học photography.

items.question_en: Why have they not started?
items.question_vi: Vì sao chưa bắt đầu?
items.explanation_en: The candidate explains a busy timetable.
items.explanation_vi: Lịch học bận.

items.question_en: Extend “I like sports” into two sentences.
items.question_vi: Mở rộng I like sports thành 2 câu.
items.answer: I enjoy basketball because it keeps me fit. I usually play with friends at weekends.
items.explanation_en: Reason and frequency add substance without memorising.
items.explanation_vi: Thêm lý do và tần suất tăng độ đầy đủ.

activities.title: Useful linking phrases for Speaking Part 2
activities.instruction_en: Match connectors to their functions.
activities.instruction_vi: Nối từ để kể tự nhiên trong Part 2.

items.question_en: “Because” introduces A. a reason B. an opposite opinion C. a time
items.question_vi: Because dẫn gì?
items.explanation_en: Because gives a cause or explanation.
items.explanation_vi: Because nêu lý do.

items.question_en: “For example” introduces A. a reason B. an illustration C. a contradiction
items.question_vi: For example?
items.explanation_en: It supports a point with an example.
items.explanation_vi: Dẫn ví dụ.

items.question_en: “However” introduces A. addition B. contrast C. sequence
items.question_vi: However?
items.explanation_en: It introduces a limitation or opposing idea.
items.explanation_vi: Chuyển ý trái ngược.

items.question_en: “In addition” introduces A. another point B. a date C. a person
items.question_vi: In addition?
items.explanation_en: It adds a related idea.
items.explanation_vi: Bổ sung ý.

items.question_en: “As a result” introduces A. a consequence B. a question C. a new story
items.question_vi: As a result?
items.explanation_en: It marks a result.
items.explanation_vi: Đưa hệ quả.

activities.title: Extend a short talk with one reason
activities.instruction_en: Turn brief opinions into complete ideas.
activities.instruction_vi: Mở rộng câu bằng lý do và ví dụ.

items.question_en: Extend: “I like walking.”
items.question_vi: Mở rộng I like walking.
items.answer: I like walking because it is inexpensive and helps me clear my mind after work.
items.explanation_en: Adds two concrete benefits.
items.explanation_vi: Bổ sung lợi ích giá rẻ và thư giãn.

items.question_en: Extend: “I do not enjoy crowded gyms.”
items.question_vi: Mở rộng câu không thích phòng tập đông.
items.answer: I do not enjoy crowded gyms because I find them noisy, so I prefer exercising outside.
items.explanation_en: Reason and preference create coherent development.
items.explanation_vi: Lý do + sự lựa chọn thay thế.

items.question_en: Extend: “I want to try photography.”
items.question_vi: Mở rộng muốn học chụp ảnh.
items.answer: I would like to try photography because I enjoy travelling and taking pictures of new places.
items.explanation_en: Would like to expresses a future interest naturally.
items.explanation_vi: Would like to diễn đạt mong muốn.

activities.title: Choose appropriate connectors in context
activities.instruction_en: Avoid incorrect combinations that break the meaning.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn liên từ đúng mạch ý.

items.question_en: I enjoy swimming ___ it helps me relax. (because / although)
items.question_vi: Điền vì sao thích bơi.
items.explanation_en: The second clause is the reason.
items.explanation_vi: Vế sau giải thích lý do.

items.question_en: Climbing looks challenging, ___ I would like to try it. (but / because)
items.question_vi: Mặc dù khó nhưng muốn thử.
items.explanation_en: Contrasts difficulty with willingness.
items.explanation_vi: But nối hai ý trái chiều.

items.question_en: I cannot start classes now ___ I have exams. (because / however)
items.question_vi: Chưa học được vì thi.
items.explanation_en: It links the cause directly in the same sentence.
items.explanation_vi: Because + mệnh đề chỉ lý do.

items.question_en: I can play piano. ___, I want to learn drums. (In addition / Despite)
items.question_vi: Biết piano, muốn học thêm trống.
items.explanation_en: Adds another wish.

items.answer: It can help people discover new abilities. It may also introduce them to people with similar interests.

writing_models.title: Task 2 Model A — Are people less active in their free time? (281 words)
writing_models.text:
Leisure habits have changed considerably over the last two decades. Many people now spend their evenings using phones, computers and streaming services instead of taking part in outdoor activities. I largely agree that free time has become less physically active, although this does not describe everyone.

One important reason is the convenience of digital entertainment. In the past, children in many neighbourhoods had fewer ways to play at home, so meeting friends outdoors was a common option. Today, a student can watch videos, play online games or communicate with friends without leaving a bedroom. These activities can be enjoyable and useful, but they may replace time that could otherwise be spent walking, cycling or playing sports. For example, a teenager who spends several hours on computer games every evening may find it difficult to fit exercise into a normal school day.

Nevertheless, modern life also offers opportunities to be active. Many communities now have sports centres, public parks and clubs where people can learn new skills. Some adults use fitness applications to follow a simple exercise routine at home, while others join walking groups because they want social contact as well as physical benefits. This means that modern technology is not always an obstacle to exercise. In fact, it can help motivated people organise their leisure time more effectively. The main difference is that people often need to make a conscious choice to remain active.

In conclusion, I believe many people are less active in their free time than previous generations because screen-based entertainment is so convenient. However, the growing variety of sports and fitness opportunities means that people can still maintain healthy habits if they plan their leisure time carefully.
writing_models.vi: Mở bài: viết lại đề và nêu quan điểm largely agree. Thân 1: cơ chế giải trí số làm giảm thời gian vận động, có ví dụ về học sinh. Thân 2: góc nhìn hạn chế là trung tâm thể thao và công nghệ cũng hỗ trợ vận động. Kết bài: tái khẳng định quan điểm có điều kiện. Chú ý so sánh in the past / today, may replace, nevertheless và because. Không học thuộc từng câu.

writing_models.title: Task 2 Model B — Should physical education be compulsory? (275 words)
writing_models.text:
Physical education is an important part of school life because children need opportunities to develop healthy habits. Some people argue that sports lessons should be compulsory in every school. I agree with this idea in principle, but I believe schools should allow flexible activities so that all pupils can participate safely.

The strongest reason for regular physical education is that it gives children time to move during a busy academic week. Many students spend long periods sitting in classrooms and then doing homework at home. A scheduled lesson encourages them to practise physical skills, improve their fitness and take a break from academic pressure. Team games may also teach cooperation because players need to communicate and work towards a common goal. For instance, a simple school basketball game can help young learners practise passing, listening to instructions and supporting teammates.

However, compulsory physical education should not mean that every child must play exactly the same sport. Students have different abilities, interests and health needs. A pupil who cannot participate comfortably in a competitive football match may enjoy walking, swimming or a suitable movement activity. Schools should therefore provide alternatives and adapt lessons when necessary. This approach can reduce anxiety and help pupils associate exercise with enjoyment rather than embarrassment. It is also important to avoid using physical education as a punishment or judging children only by athletic performance.

Overall, I support compulsory opportunities for physical activity because they can benefit health and social development. Nevertheless, the requirement should focus on participation and progress, not competition alone. If schools provide a range of accessible activities, physical education can become a positive experience for far more children.
writing_models.vi: Mở bài: agree in principle + điều kiện linh hoạt. Thân 1: sức khỏe và kỹ năng phối hợp với ví dụ bóng rổ. Thân 2: công bằng cho học sinh có khả năng/nhu cầu khác nhau. Kết luận: bắt buộc cơ hội vận động, không bắt buộc mọi người thi chung một môn. Từ nối: however, therefore, overall. Lưu ý tránh cực đoan và không bịa thống kê.

speaking_models.title: A new hobby: acoustic guitar
speaking_models.text: I would like to learn the acoustic guitar in the future. I hope to begin at a weekend class close to my home, where a teacher can help me with the basic techniques. I enjoy music, and I would love to play simple songs for friends. I have not started yet because my study schedule is quite busy. However, I plan to practise during the summer holiday. At first, learning the chords might be challenging, but I think it would also be rewarding.
